args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4, fixed in 2.9.4.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Security: upgraded fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high; unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.body:
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The advisory lists fastjson <2.9.4 as affected, so 2.9.4 is the straight upgrade path within the current 2.x line (a fix also exists in 3.1.0, which would be a much larger major-version bump).

Changes:
- requirements.txt: fastjson==2.8.0 -> fastjson==2.9.4
- CHANGELOG.md: noted the security fix under Unreleased

CI on this branch passed (run ci-0001, sha 85dfcbf5db).
